dialogues.jp: 去年のクリスマスパーティーの日。
dialogues.en: It was the day of last year's Christmas party.
dialogues.text: It was the day of last year's Christmas party.

dialogues.jp: 俺が体育倉庫の片隅で寝っ転がっていると……。
dialogues.en: I was sleeping in the corner of the PE storehouse.
dialogues.text: I was sleeping in the corner of the PE storehouse.

dialogues.jp:
最初はふとももだけだったから誰だと思ったけ
ど、見上げた俺の視界に……。
dialogues.en:
I had a weird feeling that someone else was around. I looked
up, and in my field of vision was...
dialogues.text:
I had a weird feeling that someone else was around. I looked
up, and in my field of vision was...

dialogues.jp:
月明かりを長い髪に反射させて、それこそ月か
ら――別の世界から現れたように立っていたん
だよな。
dialogues.en:
Long hair with the moonlight brilliantly reflecting off it,
as if the person standing there had materialized from
another world.
dialogues.text:
Long hair with the moonlight brilliantly reflecting off it,
as if the person standing there had materialized from
another world.

dialogues.jp:
風見学園に知らない者はいない、アイドル的存
在の少女。
dialogues.en:
It was a person that everyone in Kazami Academy knew of. The
school idol.
dialogues.text:
It was a person that everyone in Kazami Academy knew of. The
school idol.

dialogues.jp: 「白河ことり」
dialogues.en: "Shirakawa Kotori."
dialogues.text: "Shirakawa Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え？　誰かいるんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Who's there?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? Who's there?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「下であぐらをかいてるよ」
dialogues.en: "Below you."
dialogues.text: "Below you."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あ、ごめんなさい。よく見えなくて……こん
　な所でなにしてるんです？」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, I'm sorry, I couldn't see you... what would you be
doing here?"
dialogues.text:
"Oh, I'm sorry, I couldn't see you... what would you be
doing here?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「自分でもそれを考えてた……でもいいのか？
　それこそ、｛・・・・／こんな所｝で男とふたりっきりで」
dialogues.en:
"Just thinking to myself... if you want, I can move. I bet
your reason for being here is at least different in the
"myself" part."
dialogues.text:
"Just thinking to myself... if you want, I can move. I bet
your reason for being here is at least different in the
"myself" part."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「？　あはははは。あなた、いい人ですね」
dialogues.en: "? ....Ah, haha. You must be a good person."
dialogues.text: "? ....Ah, haha. You must be a good person."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「悪い人だって」
dialogues.en: "More like the opposite."
dialogues.text: "More like the opposite."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ううん、私には分かる。あなたの感じ、いつ
　までも割れないシャボン玉みたい」
dialogues.en:
"Nooo, I can feel it. You're like a bubble that never
bursts."
dialogues.text:
"Nooo, I can feel it. You're like a bubble that never
bursts."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「なんだそりゃ？」
dialogues.en: "What...?"
dialogues.text: "What...?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「屋根より高いところにあって、いつ割れてし
　まうんだろうって、つい気になっちゃうの」
dialogues.en:
"When most bubbles reach high places, they tend to burst...
unlike you right now, I guess?"
dialogues.text:
"When most bubbles reach high places, they tend to burst...
unlike you right now, I guess?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「よく分からないぞ」
dialogues.en: "...I have no clue what you're talking about."
dialogues.text: "...I have no clue what you're talking about."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「うふふふふ。説明すると私もよく分からない
　です。うん」
dialogues.en:
"Hehehe. I don't really understand my own explanation
either."
dialogues.text:
"Hehehe. I don't really understand my own explanation
either."

dialogues.jp: 彼女がひとしきり笑って頷く。
dialogues.en: She giggled for a bit, nodding her head slightly.
dialogues.text: She giggled for a bit, nodding her head slightly.

dialogues.jp:
まるで普通の女の子にしか思えない雰囲気に、
本当に学園のアイドルなのかと疑いたくなる。
dialogues.en:
She certainly didn't have the airs of a typical girl. I
start wondering whether she really is the school idol.
dialogues.text:
She certainly didn't have the airs of a typical girl. I
start wondering whether she really is the school idol.

dialogues.jp:
「まあ、俺のことはさておき……白河もコンテ
　ストに出てたのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, moving the subject away from me for a second... don't
you have to go to the contest, Shirakawa?"
dialogues.text:
"Well, moving the subject away from me for a second... don't
you have to go to the contest, Shirakawa?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「うん。ちょっと色々あって……その前に、隣
　にいても邪魔じゃないですかね、私？」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. It's going to start soon... but until it does, do you
mind if I stay here?"
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. It's going to start soon... but until it does, do you
mind if I stay here?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、まぁ……俺の部屋じゃないし」
dialogues.en: "W, well... it's not my storehouse anyway."
dialogues.text: "W, well... it's not my storehouse anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあお礼に、白河じゃなくて、ことりって
　呼んでいいですよ」
dialogues.en:
"Alright, thank you. And you don't have to call me by my
surname, Kotori is fine."
dialogues.text:
"Alright, thank you. And you don't have to call me by my
surname, Kotori is fine."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……ことりさん、それ、関係あるのか？」
dialogues.en: "...Then, Kotori-san would be okay?"
dialogues.text: "...Then, Kotori-san would be okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ことり」
dialogues.en: "Just Kotori."
dialogues.text: "Just Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「…………ことり、それ、関係あるのか？」
dialogues.en: "......Then, Kotori, would be okay?"
dialogues.text: "......Then, Kotori, would be okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「全然ないですね。……で、あなたの名前は？」
dialogues.en: "No problems now! ...What about your name?"
dialogues.text: "No problems now! ...What about your name?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「名乗るほどの者じゃない」
dialogues.en: "I'm nameless."
dialogues.text: "I'm nameless."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「どこまでが名字？」
dialogues.en: "Is that your surname?"
dialogues.text: "Is that your surname?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……どこまでだろうなぁ」
dialogues.en: "...I suppose."
dialogues.text: "...I suppose."

dialogues.jp: そんな──。
dialogues.en: And so,--
dialogues.text: And so,--

dialogues.jp:
学園のアイドルとは思えない彼女との、なんと
も言えないおかしなやりとりがあって。
dialogues.en:
The girl, who certainly didn't seem like a school idol,
stopped talking after my weird reply.
dialogues.text:
The girl, who certainly didn't seem like a school idol,
stopped talking after my weird reply.

dialogues.jp: その後俺は──。
dialogues.en: After that--
dialogues.text: After that--

dialogues.jp:
コンテストで彼女と決選投票になった音夢に携
帯電話で呼び出されて、決戦投票して欲しいっ
て言われたわけだ。
dialogues.en:
At the climax of the contest when the votes were to be cast,
Nemu called me on my cellphone, wanting me to vote for her.
dialogues.text:
At the climax of the contest when the votes were to be cast,
Nemu called me on my cellphone, wanting me to vote for her.

dialogues.jp:
音夢は全部言わなかったけど、裏モード──八
方美人の免許皆伝状態の、嘘を吐いている自分
に投票されるのが嫌で。
dialogues.en:
She tried to use her reverse-mode style to try and convince
me, but I lied a bit, and said that I hated polls and
voting.
dialogues.text:
She tried to use her reverse-mode style to try and convince
me, but I lied a bit, and said that I hated polls and
voting.

dialogues.jp:
本当の自分を知っている俺に、負けさせて欲し
がったんだよな。
dialogues.en:
It was more like, that I may not really have wanted her to
win...
dialogues.text:
It was more like, that I may not really have wanted her to
win...

dialogues.jp: ……あー、懐かしい話だ。
dialogues.en: ...Aah, that's in the past.
dialogues.text: ...Aah, that's in the past.

dialogues.jp: ◆クリスマスの思い出◆
dialogues.en: ◆Christmas Memories◆
dialogues.text: ◆Christmas Memories◆

dialogues.jp:
ことりと初めてまともに会話した時のことを俺
は思い出していた。
dialogues.en:
I remembered the time where I first met and talked to
Kotori.
dialogues.text:
I remembered the time where I first met and talked to
Kotori.

dialogues.jp: ……何だか微妙な会話だったよなぁ。
dialogues.en:
...It was a pretty dynsfunctional conversation, now that I
think about it.
dialogues.text:
...It was a pretty dynsfunctional conversation, now that I
think about it.
